evidence_type_legend.verified: Current statement, official document, signed offer, lease, written vendor quote, official policy or live account data.
evidence_type_legend.sheet_value: Accepted planning state from the Google Sheet; may still be an assumption.
evidence_type_legend.lane_confirmed: Lane-provided fact, not yet backed by a document.
evidence_type_legend.historical_observation: Useful for planning, not a promise.

state_note: evidence_type answers what kind of evidence this is; canonical_state answers what role the value plays in current project state; verification_state answers whether anyone outside this model has confirmed it. Vocabulary and validation rules live in canonical-state.json.

assumptions.label: Base route miles Orlando to Los Angeles
assumptions.refresh_rule: Replace with the sum of actual routed legs once the itinerary is built.

assumptions.label: Detour / dog-stop mileage buffer
assumptions.refresh_rule: Reduce once real legs and overnight stops are chosen.

assumptions.label: Tundra highway fuel economy
assumptions.refresh_rule: Replace with exact truck configuration and observed highway MPG before final route budget.

assumptions.label: Blended road-trip gasoline price
assumptions.refresh_rule: Refresh 1-2 weeks before departure from a live regional average across the route states.

assumptions.label: Travel days on the road
assumptions.refresh_rule: Confirm against routed legs at 6-8 driving hours per day with a dog stop every ~2 hours.

assumptions.label: Hotel nights
assumptions.refresh_rule: Equals travel days minus arrival night; confirm with the booked itinerary.

assumptions.label: Hotel nightly rate
assumptions.refresh_rule: Replace with quoted pet-friendly rates for the actual stop cities and dates.

assumptions.label: Hotel pet fee per night
assumptions.refresh_rule: Confirm per-property; some charge per pet, some per stay, some cap the number of dogs.

assumptions.label: Lane road food, snacks and water per day
assumptions.refresh_rule: Sanity-check against the $350/week food guardrail during move week.

assumptions.label: Tolls, parking and miscellaneous road fees
assumptions.refresh_rule: Refresh once the route is fixed.

assumptions.label: Pre-trip Tundra service
assumptions.refresh_rule: Replace with a written service quote covering tires, brakes, fluids, battery and A/C.

assumptions.label: California monthly rent target
assumptions.refresh_rule: Refresh from live inventory in the target neighborhoods after an employment trigger.

assumptions.label: California security deposit
assumptions.refresh_rule: Confirm against the actual lease and current California deposit rules.

assumptions.label: Rental applications expected
assumptions.refresh_rule: Adjust to the real shortlist size at search time.

assumptions.label: Rental application fee
assumptions.refresh_rule: Confirm per listing; California caps screening fees and adjusts the cap annually.

assumptions.label: Pet deposit / move-in pet fees
assumptions.refresh_rule: Split into refundable pet deposit vs non-refundable pet rent once a lease is in hand.

assumptions.label: Mover or container
assumptions.refresh_rule: Replace with written quotes after the trigger; price moves with inventory volume and dates.

assumptions.label: Packing supplies
assumptions.refresh_rule: Refresh after the Move/Sell/Store/Donate inventory is complete.

assumptions.label: Mover insurance / declared valuation
assumptions.refresh_rule: Quote against actual declared value; released-value coverage is not real coverage.

assumptions.label: Utility and internet setup
assumptions.refresh_rule: Confirm deposits/activation fees with the actual providers at the leased address.

assumptions.label: First-week household basics
assumptions.refresh_rule: Rises if more bulky items are sold rather than moved (bed is currently sell-before-move).

assumptions.label: Move contingency
assumptions.refresh_rule: Should stay unspent. Re-size upward if TBDs resolve high.

assumptions.label: Orlando housing overlap after departure
assumptions.refresh_rule: Sell branch: drive from realistic days-on-market plus closing. Rent branch: drive from tenant placement time.

assumptions.label: Orlando scheduled monthly mortgage payment
assumptions.refresh_rule: Recheck after any escrow analysis; taxes and insurance move escrow.

assumptions.label: Replacement house-health inspection
assumptions.refresh_rule: Replace with a quoted fee from the replacement inspector (Glenn has retired).

assumptions.label: Final deep clean
assumptions.refresh_rule: Quote a vacant-home deep clean including appliances and windows.

assumptions.label: Yard / curb-appeal cleanup
assumptions.refresh_rule: Quote with the listing or tenant-ready scope.

assumptions.label: Handyman / small repairs
assumptions.refresh_rule: Re-scope entirely after the replacement inspection classifies items must / soon / cosmetic / specialist.

assumptions.label: Orlando outstanding principal
assumptions.refresh_rule: Refresh at each statement; matters for seller net.

assumptions.label: Orlando mortgage interest rate
assumptions.refresh_rule: Fixed; no refresh expected.

assumptions.label: Principal and interest
assumptions.refresh_rule: Fixed unless refinanced.

assumptions.label: Escrow (taxes and insurance)
assumptions.refresh_rule: Re-verify after each escrow analysis; a non-homestead rental changes the tax picture in Florida.

assumptions.label: Property management fee
assumptions.refresh_rule: Replace with written fee schedules from the three firms contacted.

assumptions.label: Vacancy reserve
assumptions.refresh_rule: Refresh from PM placement-time estimates for the actual submarket.

assumptions.label: Maintenance reserve
assumptions.refresh_rule: A 1928 bungalow may not behave like a 6% reserve; re-set after the replacement inspection.

assumptions.label: Modeled Orlando market rent
assumptions.refresh_rule: Replace with property-manager market-rent and quick-rent opinions; this is the single largest unproven input in the rent branch.

assumptions.label: Landlord reserve held for the rental branch
assumptions.refresh_rule: Reserve size is itself part of the opportunity-cost decision; prior review point was $8,000.

assumptions.label: House readiness reserve (smaller items)
assumptions.refresh_rule: Refine after inspection / walkthrough.

assumptions.label: Maximum acceptable average monthly rental subsidy
assumptions.refresh_rule: Only Lane changes this.

assumptions.label: California Launch Fund headline floor
assumptions.refresh_rule: This is an initial minimum, not the move budget. The common physical move already exceeds it.
